verificationSummary: The 2026-09-03 Project Control source-docs subgroup split keeps source-docs as the umbrella gate while giving PLAN and WORK lanes focused scripts for source-docs:core-migration, source-docs:live-draft, source-docs:template-builder, source-docs:text-block, and source-docs:text-engine. This does not lower verification: npm run check still delegates to check:grouped and keeps check:data, type-check, grouped unit tests, build, and e2e. This does not edit Core, Backend, or Editor behavior, does not prove product-repository readiness, and does not promote FlowDoc product truth.
